text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen is a special G1 race. The only Umamusume who are allowed to run it are those voted in by fans.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer, I've got the jitters! My legs are starting to shake too. I might be scared…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: But I'm still gonna do this!
choice_data_list: Good. You've got the people's vote behind you, so hold your head high!
Good. You've got the people's vote behind you, so hold your head high!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: People hardly noticed Kitasan Black at first, but as time passed, her popularity crept up steadily.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: This year's fan rankings are in! In third…

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: It's Kitasan Black!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hello, everyone! Thank you so much for your support! I won't let you down!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now, she's climbed all the way up to third place. She's proved to everyone the value of steady, persistent effort.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And claiming the honor of this year's most popular Umamusume is—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fsshhh… fsshhh…

text_block_list.name: Local Fisherman
text_block_list.text: Mngh?! The heck is that comin' in from the ocean? No way…

text_block_list.name: Local Fisherman
text_block_list.text: I-it's a boat! A big gold'n boat!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Peace, peace! There's nothing like raking in snow crabs aboard a gold shipping boat! Coming to you live, it's the one and only Gold Shiiip!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The whole area erupts in applause as Gold Ship makes a surprise entrance from out of nowhere.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yo, Kitasan. Looks like you've finally made port at this fishery.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah! The beach is where everything clicked for me!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit! Bring it on! You were nothing but small fry this summer…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Now lemme see if you've managed to become a real whopper yet! First up, strike a pose!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: You've gotta do it like this! Just so! C'mon, show me what you've got!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Like this? I can't afford to mess up during the big moment, so I've got to nail this while I can!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Please show me how it's done, Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fun concerts and fierce races—that's a year-end festival in a nutshell. Now, Kitasan Black takes on Gold Ship the Unsinkable Battleship!
